content.title: Concept Board Performance | Persistent Reference, Mecha Action and Design Proof
content.summary: An adult rescue-mecha pilot proves a concept sheet through walk, deployment and tool test. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult original character remains continuous. + The reference strip stays visible and registered. + Each live action maps to a sheet component. + Mechanical deployment precedes the tool test. + The final pose reconnects the moving design to its concept evidence.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original adult rescue-mecha pilot above a persistent lower reference strip showing front, back and tool silhouettes. Open two folded rescue arms from her back and align them with the reference silhouettes below. Settle into a full-body inspection pose above the unchanged reference strip for the final hold.
required_anchors: One clearly adult original character remains continuous.
The reference strip stays visible and registered.
Mechanical deployment precedes the tool test.
The final pose reconnects the moving design to its concept evidence.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult rescue-mecha pilot proves a concept sheet through walk, deployment and tool test. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 把角色概念板固定为持续参考层，同一成年机甲角色从步行、结构展开到武器动作逐级实演；每个动作都能回查到板上的轮廓、配色和部件。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult original character remains continuous.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult original character remains continuous."

invariants.rule: The reference strip stays visible and registered.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The reference strip stays visible and registered."

invariants.rule: Each live action maps to a sheet component.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Each live action maps to a sheet component."

invariants.rule: Mechanical deployment precedes the tool test.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Mechanical deployment precedes the tool test."

invariants.rule: The final pose reconnects the moving design to its concept evidence.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final pose reconnects the moving design to its concept evidence."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
